{{Quote|Where do we go ''[&hellip;]'' My home is in a different&mdash;|Trevik, to a [[Unidentified Circling|Circling]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />|translated=1}}
The [[Quesoth]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trevik]] owned a '''home''' located beneath the residences owned by the members of the governing [[Circling]] caste within the [[Red City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]</ref> the Quesoth who had become the [[bowlcarrier]] for his ruler, the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]], carrying a bowl of [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] for her, was intercepted by a [[Unidentified Circling|Circling]] on his way home. Trevik was then brought to a Midli's home, where his [[Trevik's family|brother]] [[Jirvin]] tasked him with recording the paintings within the [[Dwelling of Guests]] building that had been brought there by the [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]. That [[Standard day/Legends|night]], Trevik slept poorly; the next one, after giving the recordings to his brother, he slept deeply.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The building appeared in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and included in ''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
